text:
carla: Morning all-hands async — quick round: what I did yesterday / blockers / today. Highlights: landed model-routing PR, staged canary for dedupe cache. Asks: 1) need +1 review on PR-632 (latency fix) 2) anyone on-call can check canary logs after 10:30 PT? 3) any security reviews needed for new KMS flow? :wave:

ben: 🚀 landed the autoscaler tweaks; throughput up ~18% on perf tests. No blockers. I'll follow up on PR-632 review today.

alice: pushed updated docs for private deploy network setup — link: https://intra/docs/private-networking. Need a quick spellcheck pass. Blocker: waiting on infra creds for customer P-24.

dinesh: Can someone from eng-sre confirm the canary perf job? I saw some OOMs on gpu-02 around 03:12 UTC. Not sure if related to the new batching.

frank-bot: deploy-bot: Canary rollout started for model-routing v3 -> 5% traffic. Build: sha:abc123

carla: @dinesh I'll look at gpu-02 logs now. If it's OOM we may reduce batch size. @alice I'll review docs in ~30m.

eve: quick heads up — retail POC demo scheduled for Wed 9am PT; would love a 10-minute sync to review failure modes. @carla can you join?

carla: yes, adding to calendar. Also ask: if anyone can do a quick eval run against prompt-set "summarize-ops" and paste results here (just 3 samples) so we can compare pre/post quant.

georg: I can run that after lunch and share outputs. Small note: PR-627 has merge conflicts with main — tagging @ben for resolution.

ben: noted, resolving conflicts now. Also postmortem draft for yesterday's cache glitch is in /docs/incidents/cache-glitch-draft.md — comments welcome :memo:

alice: Checked infra creds for P-24 — raised a support ticket with Security. ETA 2 business days.

dinesh: looked at gpu-02 — OOMs were from an old model pinned to 16k context. I scaled canary node down to 8k for the test; monitoring now. No errors in last 20m.

carla: thanks team. Action items: ben -> review PR-632, georg -> run eval and paste samples, alice -> follow up on creds, dinesh -> keep an eye on canary, everyone -> skim postmortem. I'll consolidate updates before EOD. :checkered_flag:

frank: +1 on PR-632, and I can help with the demo slides Wed.

carla: closing loop — last update: canary stable for 30m, no regressions observed. will post summary in #all-hands later today. Thanks! :tada:
